releaseNotes:
• Fix: Android 14–17 Screen Cast Persistence — dedicated ScreenCastForegroundService (`foregroundServiceType=mediaProjection`), default-display MediaProjectionConfig, and ProjectionPromptActivity dismiss race fix so Screen Cast never drops shortly after granting permission.
• Fix: Streaming Clothed Kissing & Forward Skip (Nuvio, Stremio, CloudStream) — re-calibrated MobileCLIP prompts & temperature (`logitScale=85`) with widescreen/face-centered crop, instant trigger on strong kissing frames, and HUD-wake + KEYCODE_MEDIA_FAST_FORWARD seek.
